## Project at a glance

| | |
|---|---|
| **Capacity** | 3,200 MW, four 800 MW combined cycle gas turbine (CCGT) units |
| **Power plant site** | 40 ha in Vinh Hau A Commune, Hoa Binh District |
| **LNG import** | Floating storage (and regasification) unit on about 100 ha of sea surface, 150,000–174,000 m³ LNG storage |
| **Gas supply** | Regasification station and 35 km high-pressure gas pipeline |
| **Location** | Bac Lieu Province, Mekong Delta, Vietnam |
| **Investor** | Delta Offshore Energy Pte. Ltd. (Singapore), 100% foreign direct investment |
| **Investment** | About USD 4 billion (VND 93,000 billion), 15% equity and 85% debt |
| **EPC contractor** | Bechtel |
| **EIA approval** | Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE), 1 September 2021 |

## Overview

The Bac Lieu LNG-to-Power Project is the largest 100% foreign-invested project in the Mekong Delta. It combines a 3,200 MW combined cycle power plant onshore with an offshore floating LNG storage and regasification unit, linked by a 35 km high-pressure gas pipeline. The Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) report was approved by Vietnam's Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment on 1 September 2021, a key permitting milestone for the project.

## My role

- Contributed to the **Environmental Baseline**, characterising existing environmental conditions at the project site in the low-lying Mekong Delta coastal area
- Authored the **soil and groundwater impact assessment**, evaluating potential impacts on soil and groundwater from construction and operation of the power plant and associated facilities, and proposing mitigation and monitoring measures
